title: alchemilla austroaltaica
intro: Alchemilla austroaltaica, commonly known as the South Altai lady's mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine due to its multiple health benefits. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla austroaltaica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
